mapper.update: INSERT INTO procurement (merge_key, date_of_order, title, amount, government_departments, note) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{dateOfOrder}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{governmentDepartments}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_procurement (company_id, procurement_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, p.procurement_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN procurement p ON p.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, procurement_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_procurement.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_procurement.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_procurement cp SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cp.deleted = false AND cp.company_id = (SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber})

UPDATE company_procurement cp SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cp.deleted = false AND cp.company_id = (SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber}) AND cp.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
